articles.title: Benjamin Netanyahu says Iran will never have nuclear weapons 'with or without a deal'
articles.summary: Netanyahu stated at the IDF's 192nd pilot course graduation ceremony that Iran will not have nuclear weapons, emphasizing Israel's policy and past military operations against the Iranian regime.

articles.title: Donald Trump, Benjamin Netanyahu hold call about renewed Iran conflict
articles.summary: Netanyahu spoke with Trump on Thursday night about American military moves in the Gulf and coordinated on concerns regarding Turkish F-35 acquisition and regional security zones.

articles.title: Benjamin Netanyahu reiterates concerns about US-Turkey F-35 sale
articles.summary: Netanyahu told CNN that the proposed US sale of F-35 fighter jets to Turkey could disrupt regional power balance and expressed concerns about Ankara's ties to the Muslim Brotherhood and Hamas support.

articles.title: Benjamin Netanyahu: 'My relationship with President Donald Trump is excellent'
articles.summary: Netanyahu told Fox News that the US-Israel alliance remains strong despite occasional disagreements, and discussed shared goals regarding Iran's nuclear program and recent Middle East peace developments.

articles.title: Benjamin Netanyahu warns Donald Trump against sale of F-35s to Turkey
articles.summary: Netanyahu warned in a Fox and Friends interview that providing Turkey with F-35 fighter jets would upset the Middle East power balance and threaten Israeli air superiority in the region.
